about: Tuning dials. Every number the engine plays by lives here; change a value and restart the server. powerWindows: each timed power window is public (the table sees whose window is open) or hidden (decided inside a pause everyone sits through), with the seconds to decide before it counts as not used. timers: seconds before a Tertip wave passes, an Objection turn passes, Yön Değiştir and the Ferman are skipped; appointments, replacements, the Decree, Kader and Devam are never timed. Timers are off in learning games and the host can switch them off.
